伊娃的生活方式(Eva's Way of Living): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:伊娃的经历、感受与成长。

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Little by little, things began to change. OPEC meets to decide how much oil to produce.

Lily and Eva are preparing a report about the flower market. Eva wrote down every idea in a small notebook. On Monday evenings, Eva reviews the notes from class. Best of all, crosswinds tested the ferry crossing.
The experience taught Eva more than any book could. Eva thanked Lily for the honest advice. Lily advised Eva to try singing as a new hobby. In fact, a seagull stole my sandwich.

At first, Eva found it difficult to keep the habit. The flower market looked quieter than usual that evening. Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Troops reinforced the levee overnight.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Eva will take part in a volleyball match in January. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.

column3: 欧佩克(石油输出国家组织)
